claim: Maison Colette offers 5 deluxe guest rooms designed by Grain Design Office at €305 per room incl. breakfast, only bookable in combination with a dinner reservation; check-in 16:00–18:00, checkout 10:30.
quote: Five luxurious rooms ... €305 per room (accommodates 2 persons, includes breakfast). The room can only be booked in conjunction with a dinner reservation at the restaurant.

claim: Maison Colette is a restaurant with on-site lodging set in a refurbished former physician's residence at De Trannoyplein 17, Westerlo (Tongerlo).
quote: A house full of love for taste and hospitality. De Trannoyplein 17, 2260 Westerlo.

claim: Maison Colette was awarded two MICHELIN stars in the 2025 Belgium & Luxembourg guide, just four months after opening.
quote: Léa Linster and Maison Colette receive two Stars in the 2025 MICHELIN Guide Belgium & Luxembourg.

claim: Hotel Geerts at Grote Markt 50, Westerlo is a 4-star family-run hotel whose character has developed over four generations.
quote: Hotel Geerts has its own special character that has been developed over four generations. Grote Markt 50, B-2260 Westerlo.

claim: The Hotel Geerts building dates to 1728 and was last renovated in 2005; it sits 5 minutes' drive from Tongerlo Abbey on the edge of Westerlo.
quote: Hotel Geerts was built in 1728 and was last renovated in 2005 ... Tongerlo Abbey just a 5-minute drive away.

claim: Hotel Karmel occupies a former Carmelite monastery on the Grote Markt of Herentals, with 27 rooms and a heated indoor pool, sauna and hammam.
quote: Hotel Karmel ... a former Carmelite monastery that was converted into a four-star hotel ... 27 guest rooms ... heated indoor swimming pool, sauna, hammam.

claim: De Watermolen in Kasterlee is a 17th-century working watermill turned hotel-restaurant complex at Houtum 61 along the Kleine Nete, with Brasserie De Watermolen and fine-dining Restaurant Terlo on site.
quote: Historic 17th-century watermill ... Brasserie De Watermolen (open daily) and Restaurant Terlo (fine dining, Friday-Sunday). Houtum 61, 2460 Kasterlee.

claim: De Watermolen has 16 luxuriously equipped rooms and 2 suites and is described as 'a magnificent 17th-century water mill full of charm'.
quote: magnificent 17th-century water mill full of charm ... 16 luxuriously equipped rooms or 2 spacious suites.

claim: Het Wevershuis is a B&B inside an 1880 neoclassical director's residence in central Herentals; it opened in April 2024 after a multi-generational family restoration.
quote: Bed and breakfast offering comfortable luxury accommodation ... beautifully renovated mansion from 1880 ... opened its doors in April 2024.

claim: B&B 't Convent occupies a house in the medieval Begijnhof of Herentals (Begijnhof 17) and offers three individually designed rooms in 'an oasis of peace and comfort'.
quote: An ancient beguinage ... an oasis of peace and comfort in the heart of the city. Begijnhof 17, 2200 Herentals.

claim: B&B De ZIL is a 3-room B&B at Zillekespad 2, Herselt, set inside Landschapspark de Merode forest, ~5 km south of Maison Colette.
quote: Three cosy double rooms in the Flemish region called the Kempen ... located in Zillekespad 2, 2230 Herselt ... in the heart of Landschapspark de Merode.

claim: Hostel Boswachtershuis is the renovated former forester's house in the Beeltjens nature reserve in Westerlo, sleeping 17 from €15–27 per person, with a whimsical 'gnomes and talking dolls' theme curated by host Elly over 20 years.
quote: Youth hostel 'Boswachtershuis' ... used to be the forester's house ... a place where children now play, gnomes live and dolls can talk ... 17 people ... €15.00 - €27.00 per person.

claim: Tongerlo Abbey's guesthouse (Bisschopshuis + Prelatuur) accepts only multi-night spiritual-retreat guests — minimum 4 nights — and is therefore not viable for a single Saturday-night dinner stay.
quote: Overnight stays require minimum 4-night bookings — single-night stays are not permitted. Participation in liturgical prayer times is highly valued and recommended.

claim: Westerlo tourism's official directory lists 8 B&Bs, 3 hotels, 4 campgrounds and several holiday rentals within the municipality.
quote: Bed & Breakfasts (8) ... Hotels (3) ... Campgrounds (4).

claim: B&B Carpe Diem in Westerlo has two Merode-themed rooms (Gravin de Merode, Prins de Merode) with a private mezzanine sitting area overlooking the Nete.
quote: Gravin de Merode ... Prins de Merode ... guest floor has a private sitting area ... breakfast served on the mezzanine with a view of the River Nete.

claim: Westerlo lists local taxi companies including Taxi Westel (Verlorenkost 5, +32 483 16 72 40), serving evening trips to and from Maison Colette.
quote: Taxi Westel ... Verlorenkost 5 ... +32 483 16 72 40.

claim: B&B Wolf & Belle is a one-room B&B in the Beeltjens nature reserve whose garden gives directly onto the Beeltjensdreef walking area.
quote: Characterful bed and breakfast in the Westelse Beeltjens ... the garden gives directly out on the Beeltjensdreef and you thus literally step into the Merode walking area.

claim: Westerlo to Herentals is approximately 12 km by road, a 15–20 minute drive.
quote: Westerlo - Herentals afstand.

claim: Distance reference: Westerlo to Herselt ≈ 5 km, Kasterlee ≈ 17 km, Vorselaar ≈ 18 km.
quote: Afstand van Westerlo naar...

claim: Maison Colette's interiors and guest-room design were executed by Grain Design Office.
quote: Grain Designoffice | Maison Colette.
